Daniel Radcliffe succeeds nicely as a musical comedy performer in the okay Broadway revival of “How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying” that opened on Sunday at the Theatre.
Individually, the entire cast is quite strong, but what they collectively lack is chemistry.

cn.t: Radcliffe earns praise for his earnest, energetic musical debut, though critics find the revival itself charming but dated and lacking magic, with mixed chemistry among the cast.
